description_zh: 将客户聊天、会议记录和零散资料整理成需求确认书，明确交付范围、待确认问题与验收标准。
description_en: Turn client notes into traceable requirement drafts, delivery scope and acceptance questions across industries.
author: zcjunblog
examples_zh: 把客户聊天整理成需求确认书，标出还没说清楚的地方。
对照会议记录和方案，找出交付范围与时间上的冲突。
整理这次培训的客户要求，生成交付清单和建议验收方式。
examples_en: Turn these client notes into a requirements draft with unresolved questions.
Compare the meeting notes and proposal to identify delivery scope and scheduling conflicts.
Organize the client requirements for this training into a delivery checklist and suggested acceptance criteria.
